Author: ofnature
Name: Ariadne
Punchline: Hands your fleet the thread — ready navmeshes the moment a zone loads.
Description: Bridge between the game session and Mnemosyne, an out-of-process navmesh cache. Detects zone loads, fetches cached meshes so vnavmesh skips its build, and exposes IPC so other plugins can request meshes or paths directly.
